prose: A short-window linear approximation is used to keep the analysis of nonlinear and time-varying structural degradation tractable and suitable for online evaluation. It may not be accurate during brief intervals of rapid property change. It is typically accurate before and after these intervals and during periods when degradation evolves slowly.
